title: One effect type carried through stages 7-9
description: Where a type's candidate models stand after being rendered and compared to the unit's own takes. `p0` says what was rendered, `p1` and `p2` say how the comparison came out (or what stopped it), and a type that was never in scope carries `excluded` instead of either. Checked by hand, the same way `inference.json` is: this file states the shape and a test in `tests/test_inferences_layout.py` reads it.

equivalent_under_this_test.description: Rows the comparison at this stage could not ask -- a model's delay row under `waves`, where a per-take recording offset already absorbs it (subtracted() takes the offset up before either side is scored).

invocation.description: The arguments the comparison was run with, so a stage can be reproduced without re-deriving them from the ledger.

rendered_with.description: The numpy and scipy versions the rendering ran under, carried from the rendered directory's manifest.

rendered_on.description: The take directories this model was rendered into.

phase.description: Stage 8 (`p1`) or 9 (`p2`). The shape is the same for both; `p2` repeats the comparison on directories `p0`/`p1` did not use.

verdict.description: `passed` requires the identity control to have failed to separate on at least one compared quantity and `held_out_settings` to be non-empty -- both checked here rather than trusted from the writer.

gates.description: reproduce.gates() output, built into the waves or readings shape a comparison scores.

control.description: The identity model run through the same comparison, so a candidate is judged against something that could have failed.

input_from.description: Where the take used as input came from: the same directory, or another one matched on stimulus.

input.description: `dry`: the part with its reverb send written to 0, so with no send at all. `bypass`: the part routed past the effect, which keeps the part's own sends and so carries its reverb.

held_out_settings.description: The [directory, setting] pairs compared here that no value in the model's `fitted_on` (declared or derived) names. Empty means every compared setting was used to build the model, so the comparison could not have found the model wrong.

excluded_from_ranking.description: Candidates in this type's class with no held-out settings of their own, kept out of the power gate's ranking.

chosen_by.description: `by_repeatability_class` or `bypass_check_failed`. Mechanical either way -- no path where a person chooses.

at.description: The stage this type did not get past.

gate.description: Closed. A gate outside this list is a stage a closure count cannot read.

needs.description: Required and never empty. The measurement that would move this type off `stopped`, in the terms `inferences open` already names, plus the margin it would answer by.
